rows.html: Close planning, calendar and orchestration
Orchestrate period-end close through schedules, tasks and workflows.
Close checklists managed through Excel and manual processes.
After Redwood exit, SAP Advanced Financial Closing is being evaluated as the strategic platform for close orchestration, task automation and accrual posting.

Transaction matching
Match transactions automatically before reconciliation: bank statements, AP, AR and GR/IR.
Mainly done in legacy ERP. High volume of unmatched transactions in open items and GR/IR accounts.
No transformations ongoing.
3

Account reconciliation and certification
Account substantiation, reconciliation and certification support the financial close.

BlackLine is the primary reconciliation platform for many entities, supporting balance-sheet reconciliations, certification workflows, documentation, preparer/approver controls and audit evidence retention.
For UNIFY entities, reconciliations will temporarily be managed manually or through BlackLine offline mode while future automation options are assessed.
